patronOf.en-US: The priest prays for the faithful departed
patronOf.pt-BR: O sacerdote reza pelos fiéis defuntos

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Remember also, O Lord, Thy servants and handmaids, who are gone before us with the sign of faith, and rest in the sleep of peace.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Lembrai-Vos também Senhor, dos vossos servos e servas, que partiram antes de nós, marcados com o sinal da fé, e agora dormem o sono da paz.

meta.basis: At the Memento of the dead the priest, 'extensis et junctis manibus ante pectus, et usque ad faciem elevatis, et intentis oculis ad Sacramentum super Altare, facit commemorationem Fidelium defunctorum' (Ritus servandus IX.2). The votive candles, the wall cross and the churchyard are the painter's setting, not a rubric.
